idea-plugin.name: Copy All Problems
idea-plugin.description:
Adds an action to copy every diagnostic (errors, warnings, weak warnings, info) for the currently active file to the clipboard, one per line, formatted as:

sample/SampleWithProblems.kt:7:1 [WARNING] Unused import directive
sample/SampleWithProblems.kt:10:7 [WARNING] Class "SampleWithProblems" is never used
sample/SampleWithProblems.kt:13:17 [WARNING] Property "unusedField" is never used

Useful when you need to paste a file's full problem list into an external tool (chat, ticket, code review) and the standard Problems window copy doesn't include line numbers in your build.

Scope: copy problems from just the active file (default), all open editors, every VCS-changed file in your git working tree, or the active file's directory (recursive) — selectable under Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems.

Formats: copy as plain text, a Markdown table, or a JSON array of {path, line, col, severity, message} objects — selectable in the same settings panel.

AI prompt: the separate Copy All Problems as AI Prompt action (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+A / ⌘+Shift+Alt+A) copies the list in your chosen format prefixed with a customizable instruction header, ready to paste straight into an AI assistant.

Source-line context: optionally attach each problem's offending line of code, integrated into the active format (an indented line in plain text, a Code column in Markdown, a code field in JSON) — off by default, handy with the AI prompt.

Reformat before copying: optionally run the IDE "Reformat Code" action first, so whitespace/formatting warnings are fixed and dropped from the copied list (off by default).

How to use: right-click in the editor → Copy All Problems with Line Numbers, or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+P (Windows/Linux) / ⌘+Shift+Alt+P (Mac).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.15
  • Compatibility: raised the supported IDE range to include 2026.2 (build 262).
  • Internal: replaced deprecated and internal IntelliJ SDK API usages (combo-box renderer, plugin-version lookup) so the plugin verifies cleanly against the newer platforms.
1.0.14
  • New Default scope setting (Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems): choose which files the action copies problems from — the active file (default, unchanged), all open editors, VCS-changed files (the git working-tree changes; nothing to scan when the project isn't under version control), or the active file's directory (recursive). Multi-file scopes emit a per-file grouped list with a # path header for each file.
  • Open editors and the active file read already-computed diagnostics; the VCS-changed and directory scopes run analysis on demand (with a cancelable progress bar) and report errors and warnings.
  • New Output format setting: copy the problems as plain text (the original path:line:col [SEVERITY] description lines, default), a Markdown table (pastes cleanly into a PR or issue), or a JSON array of {path, line, col, severity, message} objects (handy for piping into a script or an AI assistant).
  • New Copy All Problems as AI Prompt action (editor right-click / Tools menu / Ctrl+Shift+Alt+A): copies the problem list (in your chosen output format) prefixed with a customizable instruction header, ready to paste straight into an AI assistant.
  • New Include source-line context option: attaches each problem's offending line of code, integrated into the active format (an extra indented line in plain text, a Code column in Markdown, a code field in JSON). Off by default; especially useful with the AI Prompt action.
1.0.13
  • New Reformat before copying option (Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems → Behavior): when enabled, the file is reformatted (the IDE "Reformat Code" action) before diagnostics are collected, so whitespace/formatting warnings are fixed and excluded from the copied list. Off by default — the normal behavior is unchanged.
  • New full path for files outside the project option: for files with no project-relative path (library sources, scratch files), choose between the bare file name (default) and the full absolute path.
  • The settings panel (Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems) now shows the installed plugin version in its footer.
1.0.12
  • Problem locations are now reported as a project-relative path (e.g. sample/SampleWithProblems.kt:42:5) instead of just the file name, so files that share a name across different directories are no longer ambiguous. Files outside the project fall back to the plain file name.
  • Broadened IDE compatibility: the plugin now installs on IntelliJ-platform IDEs back to 2022.2 (build 222), not just 2024.2+. It is built to Java 17 bytecode, so a single build runs across 2022.2 through 2026.1.
  • Updated build-time dependencies to patched versions to clear security advisories. No change to the shipped plugin.
1.0.11
  • New Notification style setting (Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems): choose how the result is reported — modal popup with OK (default, unchanged from 1.0.1+), balloon notification, editor hint near the caret, or silent (no notification at all). Pick a non-modal style to skip the OK click.
1.0.10
  • Replaced internal DaemonCodeAnalyzerImpl.getHighlights(...) call with the recommended DaemonCodeAnalyzerEx.processHighlights(...) entry point, clearing the JetBrains Marketplace "internal API usage" warning.
  • Added LICENSE.md (MIT) and a settings-panel screenshot to the README.
1.0.9
  • Filtered out non-problem highlights that the Problems tool window already hides: symbol-coloring annotations (severity below INFORMATION, e.g. "Automatically declared based on the expected type") and annotator-only INFORMATION markers (URL hyperlinks like "Open in browser (Ctrl+Click, Ctrl+B)", identifier highlighting, etc.).
  • Real INFORMATION-level inspection results (e.g. unused-symbol hints) are still included when the INFORMATION checkbox is on.
1.0.8
  • Internal build maintenance: fixed build.gradle.kts syntax and bumped the Gradle wrapper to 9.x for compatibility with IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.16.0.
1.0.7
  • Added action icon shown in the editor right-click menu and Tools menu (light + dark variants).
1.0.6
  • Restored full release history in the plugin metadata (1.0.0 through 1.0.5 were missing from the change-notes panel).
1.0.5
  • Added plugin icon (light + dark variants).
1.0.4
  • Added STYLE_SUGGESTION severity checkbox.
  • Added "Include other / unknown severities" catch-all toggle for forward compatibility.
1.0.3
  • New Settings → Tools → Copy All Problems panel.
  • UI checkboxes for ERROR / WARNING / WEAK WARNING / INFORMATION / GRAMMAR_ERROR / TYPO / SERVER_PROBLEM severities.
  • Output format options: include column number, include [SEVERITY] tag, sort by severity first.
  • GRAMMAR_ERROR unchecked by default to reduce noise.
1.0.2
  • Hardcoded GRAMMAR_ERROR filter (later replaced by the settings panel in 1.0.3).
1.0.1
  • Switched from balloon notifications to modal popup for compatibility with PyCharm 2025.x (build 251+).
  • Bumped target IntelliJ Platform to 2025.1.
  • Bumped Kotlin compiler to 2.1.0.
1.0.0
  • Initial release.
  • Action: Copy All Problems with Line Numbers (Editor right-click, Tools menu, ⌘+Shift+Alt+P).
  • Output format: filename:line:col [SEVERITY] description, one per line.
